items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And I joined Wes's thing. Wes, now, was using a conga player and the four of us, and it was good.

ctx.x: When I went to tell Cal, I said, 'Cal, I need to talk to you about something.' I wasn't sure about the best choice of words, about Wes had asked Buddy and I to join him, and Buddy had consented to it, Buddy and I talked. And Cal said, 'Well, man, you know I can't...what can I say? I hate to see you leave because of selfish reasons, for myself,' he said, 'but if it was me, I'd do the same thing, or anybody else that was...' He said by all means to go with his good wishes, to join Wes.

And I joined Wes's thing. Wes, now, was using a conga player and the four of us, and it was good. Now Buddy's playing piano, I'm still playing the upright bass. I had really amplified it, I had to get an amplifier because the congas...I couldn't cut through with the bass sound. I'm playing bass and I just couldn't cut through. The congas just drowned it out. I had a great bass and...
Was Wes...On the job at this point was he playing his hit tunes?
